hypotheses.B0_single_edit_effects_are_balanced: The median smaller/larger individual probability-effect norm ratio is at least 0.50.
hypotheses.B1_balancing_increases_two_source_suppor: The median minority-position top-64 share exceeds the fixed-newline assay by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.B2_both_sources_are_material: The median minority-position top-64 share is at least 0.10.
hypotheses.B3_near12_gradient_fidelity: The next-twelve attention program reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 in every layer/pair cell.
hypotheses.B4_near12_finite_direction: The prospective fixed-budget patch has the intended finite direction on at least 90% of sites in every cell.
hypotheses.B5_near12_retains_exact_effect: The prospective patch retains at least 80% of the exact-selector mean effect in every cell.
hypotheses.B6_output_interaction_is_material: The median two-edit interaction norm is at least 5% of the joint probability-change norm.
